description: Erection of a first floor side and a part single, part two storey side and rear extension to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (869 - PL03 - 01; 869 - PL03 - 02; 869 - PL03 - 03; 869 - PL03 - 04 (Rev B); 869 - PL03 - 05 (Rev B); 869 - PL03 - 06 (Rev B); 869 - PL03 - 07; 869 - PL03 - 08 (Rev B)  Received:  18 August 2020;  
TQRQM19078093221277 / 869  Received:  08 June 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the existing part two storey, part single storey side and rear extensions hereby permitted shall match those of the original house.  The rendered walls of the extensions hereby permitted shall also match the colour scheme of the original house.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors, roof lights or other glazed openings shall be formed in the part two storey, part single storey side and rear extensions hereby approved.
